summary: One-time boot-time helper: runs the CPU feature check, stores its result into global dword_8B0108, and only when the check succeeds performs a large table copy from ROM data (returning that copy's result); otherwise returns the zero feature-check result.

operations.description: Call CPUIDFeatureCheck() and capture its return value (low byte promoted) as result.
Store the feature-check result into global dword_8B0108.
If the stored feature-check result is non-zero, take the table-copy branch; otherwise skip it.
When the check succeeded, call the ROM data table copy helper and return its result directly.
When the check failed, return the zero feature-check result.
